headers.comment: Webpack content-hashes these, so a given name never changes contents.

webApp.js has a FIXED name (outputFileName) but references content-hashed .wasm. If it is ever cached it will fetch wasm hashes that a later deploy deleted, and the app dies on a white screen. It must always revalidate.
Matches both / and /index.html; a plain /index.html source does not match a bare root request.

rewrites.comment: SPA routing for dot-free paths only (/c/{id}, /c/{id}/results, /requests, /friends per DeepLink.kt). A catch-all ** would answer a missing .wasm/.js/.ttf with index.html under a forced application/wasm content type, turning a clear 404 into a wasm compile failure.
